notes.title: Friends' Kitchen Playtest Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Friends!
We’ve made several improvements and bug fixes to make your gameplay experience smoother and more enjoyable. Here’s what’s included in this update:

[list]
[*] [b]Audio Adjustments:[/b] In-game sounds have been balanced and improved for a better auditory experience.
[*] [b]Chef AI Bug Fixes:[/b] The chef’s AI issues have been resolved, ensuring smoother kitchen operations.
[*] [b]Trash Variable Bug Fixed:[/b] The issue where variables didn’t reset correctly after throwing away multiple meals has been fixed.
[/list]
Thank you for your continued feedback and support. Happy cooking!

notes.title: Bugfix & Improvement
notes.content:
Hello, Friends!
We’re back with new improvements and fixes for the playtest version. Here’s what’s included in this update:

[list]
[*] [b]Chef Pot Issue Resolved:[/b] The chef can now interact with the pot without any problems.
[*] [b]Footstep Sounds Increased:[/b] Footstep sounds have been enhanced for a more realistic experience.
[*] [b]Ambiance Sounds Improved:[/b] Restaurant ambiance sounds have been adjusted for a better atmosphere.
[*] [b]Table Cleaning Issue Fixed:[/b] The bug where dirt disappeared before cleaning reached 100% has been resolved.
[*] [b]Table Cleaning Time Shortened:[/b] Cleaning tables is now faster and more efficient.
[*] [b]Customer Arrival Times Randomized:[/b] Customers now arrive randomly between 5-15 seconds.
[*] [b]Waiter Tutorial Bug Fixed:[/b] The issue where the tutorial text changed when the waiter interacted with the sink has been fixed.
[*] [b]Plate Pickup Issue in Chef Scene Fixed:[/b] Plates can no longer be picked up outside the sink area in the chef scene.
[*] [b]Waiter AI Scripts in Chef Scene Adjusted:[/b] Waiter AI behavior has been optimized, and related bugs have been resolved.
[/list]

With this update, we’ve made the game more enjoyable and stable. Thank you for supporting us with your feedback. Enjoy cooking!

notes.title: Bug Fix & Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Friends! We’re excited to share the latest improvements for the Friends' Kitchen playtest on Steam. With this update, we've fixed numerous bugs and enhanced gameplay for a smoother experience. Here are the changes included in this update:

[list]
[*] [b]Settings Menu Adjustments:[/b] We’ve made improvements to the settings menu to make your game experience more flexible.
[*] [b]Waiter Pause Menu:[/b] The bug affecting the waiter in the pause menu has been resolved, ensuring a smoother experience when the game is paused.
[*] [b]Waiter AI Order Position Improved:[/b] The waiter now stands in the correct position when taking orders.
[*] [b]Female Customer Voice Issue :[/b] The issue where female customers would occasionally have a male voice has been fixed. 
[*] [b]Waiter AI Bug Fixes:[/b] Various bugs in the waiter’s AI have been addressed to improve service consistency.
[*] [b]Dirt Object Visibility: [/b]The issue with the dirt object not appearing on Table 4 has been resolved, and it will now display correctly.
[*] [b]Chef AI Bug Fixes:[/b] We've improved the chef’s AI, providing a smoother kitchen experience.
[*] [b] Table Removal Bar Fixed: [/b] The bug where the table removal bar appeared full for the second customer has been fixed.
[*] [b]Order-Taking Issue:[/b] The issue with taking orders from groups of two customers has been resolved, allowing for seamless order-taking.
[/list]

With this update, we've taken important steps to make your game experience more stable. Thank you for joining the playtest and supporting us with your valuable feedback. Happy cooking!
